claim: When a precondition fails, the system emits a fixed-shape, allowlisted-field denial record — never raw stderr, paths, or secrets.
denial_type: n/a — this app emits a denial record, it does not raise

steps.label: a precondition that holds emits no record at all
steps.evidence: silence on success; a record means something failed

steps.label: a precondition that fails with a secret-bearing exception
steps.note: The exception text is where secrets leak into audit logs. The record's shape is fixed in advance, so there is nowhere for it to go.

steps.label: the emitted record carries no field outside the allowlist
steps.note: An allowlist of fields, rather than a denylist of secrets, is what makes this checkable without knowing every secret in advance.
